rule: docs/slices/locale-1.md § 8.5 rules 2-3 (and § 16.2 item 4): per en-US subject and captured URL, the exact list of byte differences between this tree and the immutable start-commit capture before/ (4e98f98), each with its category. Category 1 = a text-node consolidation (`{n} product{s}` / `{n} result{s}` became one filled count text), HTML form and payload form. Category 2 = string props a client component now receives: an added prop (`value`), or — LOCALE-1B — a prop whose value changed (`beforeValue` → `value`, both exact): the SearchBar's labels ("$undefined" → the resolved texts), the commerce views' `strings` (the 77 keys unchanged plus the 21 shared keys of 1b) and, on the catalog subjects, the Navbar's `interest` (the header widget's texts gain `strings`, LOCALE1B-WIDGET = A). Category 3 = an approved ledger change, here only L-EN-CAT on the two en-US catalog subjects (catalog, cip1b-catalog; packet hard rule 1). Checked by row loc1-diff-1b (locale-1/proof.mjs checkExpected): every listed difference must occur and nothing else may differ, under CM1-A1 plus the ruled resolved-tree payload comparison (operator ruling LOCALE1B-ROW-CUT = A, locale-1/proof.mjs resolveFlight; it replaces the 1a row renumbering): every outlined row resolved into the place that references it, on both sides. No URL is excluded. CMRC-COUNTIES-1 (2026-11-01, docs/slices/cmrc-counties-1.md) added ONE category-2 changed prop, on commerce /checkout: `CheckoutPageView.defaultRegions`, the 42 county names of the RO country pack (the former "RO" fallback) → [] (the tenant's real country, EN, has no regions); the entry carries `slice: "cmrc-counties-1"`. Nothing else in this file changed.
